name: TablePage
description: Which page of a longer list is on screen. Present, Table draws its own Pagination below the grid and names it from `label`. Table does not slice: it does not hold the rows, so the consumer passes the page they already sliced and Table draws the control over it.

index.description: The current page, 1-based, the same counting Pagination uses.

size.description: How many rows a full page holds. Table needs it to say how many pages there are, not to cut anything.

total.description: How many rows there are across every page. Required because the projected children are one page and the count of pages cannot be derived from them; it is also what lets Table notice that a filter has left the current page beyond the end and ask for page 1, which is the reset every consumer writes by hand.
